title: real dims and stage spans in gpu trace

commit.merge_subject: merge: real dims and stage spans in gpu trace

description:
The ritim-trace line's out= field is NOT the render resolution on the
GPU window path: the published frame IS the stats pack (~256 long edge),
so out= logs the pack's dims and the real develop dims are invisible —
the owner's '12MP preview is choppy' diagnosis has no numbers to stand
on. This commit adds measurement truth to the line, with NO behavior
change to any render.

Trace (RenderTrace): the GPU block appends after grade= ONLY when
servedByGpu — source=<sensor WxH> develop=<actual developed WxH>
surface=<window presented WxH> stats=<pack WxH|off> then the six
per-stage spans dec/cfa/up/dev/present/stats=<ms one decimal>. The CPU
line stays byte-identical (pinned by test), so every existing grep and
baseline leg keeps working. The ms formatting is Locale.US — a
comma-decimal device locale must not rewrite the grep format.
